entities.summary: Friendship of peoples is a concept advanced by Marxist social class theory. According to Marxism, nationalism is only a tool of the ruling class, used to keep the working class divided and thus easier to control and exploit. With the success of class struggle, the natural brotherhood of all workers would make the idea of separate nations obsolete.
